challenge.name: Agent Passport Challenge
challenge.theme: Build. Verify. Prove Your Agent Can Travel.

agent.name: Nexus OVAEL Epistemic Agent
agent.description: Modular, portable, and verifiable multi-agent epistemic reasoning and adaptive learning engine with Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Lyzr cross-runtime portability.

taxonomy.architecture: Hierarchical Multi-Agent with Bounded Ephemeral Specialists
taxonomy.reasoning_model: Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT) + Causal Gap Counterfactuals

runtimes.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
runtimes.description: Standardized protocol compatibility allowing Claude Desktop, Cursor, and any MCP client to discover and execute tools.

runtimes.name: Lyzr Agent Ecosystem
runtimes.description: Native adapter for the Lyzr framework, enabling Lyzr agents and task graphs to invoke Nexus diagnostic, socratic, and gap-analysis engines.

runtimes.name: REST / OpenAPI Gateway
runtimes.description: FastAPI HTTP API with Argon2 token authentication, idempotency validation, and strict Pydantic schemas.

runtimes.name: Standalone Portable CLI
runtimes.description: Zero-dependency offline evaluation and verification CLI for automated grading and compliance inspection.

lead_orchestration_agents.name: NavigatorAgent
lead_orchestration_agents.description: Determines narrow session state and knowledge boundary without mutating runtime authority directly.

lead_orchestration_agents.name: TutorAgent
lead_orchestration_agents.description: Executes Socratic dialogue, worked examples, and adaptive challenge progression under strict quality gates.

lead_orchestration_agents.name: MemoryCuratorAgent
lead_orchestration_agents.description: Consolidates session evidence into vectorless grounded memory without retaining raw learner prompt text.

lead_orchestration_agents.name: SamAgent
lead_orchestration_agents.description: Analyzes learner response patterns, confidence calibration, and causal misconceptions.

lead_orchestration_agents.name: CarlAgent
lead_orchestration_agents.description: Computes Bayesian state transitions, difficulty scaling, and counterfactual remedial pathways.

lead_orchestration_agents.name: TravAgent
lead_orchestration_agents.description: Audits cross-lead consistency, verifies provenance boundaries, and signs specialist execution traces.

lead_orchestration_agents.name: IrisAgent
lead_orchestration_agents.description: Synthesizes causal gap cases, counterfactual interventions, and diagnostic failure graphs.

lead_orchestration_agents.name: XAgent
lead_orchestration_agents.role: Execution, Parallel Specialist Dispatcher & Final Synthesis
lead_orchestration_agents.description: Assigns bounded token budgets to ephemeral specialists and synthesizes unified pedagogical moves.

ephemeral_specialists.name: prerequisite_analyst
ephemeral_specialists.purpose: Identify the smallest plausible prerequisite blocker from scoped evidence.

ephemeral_specialists.name: difficulty_analyst
ephemeral_specialists.purpose: Check whether the next challenge target is appropriate for current uncertainty.

ephemeral_specialists.name: pedagogy_critic
ephemeral_specialists.purpose: Critique the proposed teaching action and prefer the least intrusive effective move.

ephemeral_specialists.name: transfer_designer
ephemeral_specialists.purpose: Define what independent transfer evidence would verify learning rather than recall.

ephemeral_specialists.name: scaffolding_critic
ephemeral_specialists.purpose: Check that scaffolding repairs the gap without unnecessarily lowering challenge.

ephemeral_specialists.name: source_coverage_critic
ephemeral_specialists.purpose: Check whether authorized sources sufficiently cover the current information need.

ephemeral_specialists.name: provenance_critic
ephemeral_specialists.purpose: Check source provenance and flag unverified/private evidence boundaries.

ephemeral_specialists.name: context_budget_critic
ephemeral_specialists.purpose: Keep source context bounded to the smallest useful evidence subset.

ephemeral_specialists.name: evidence_quality_auditor
ephemeral_specialists.purpose: Check whether the causal claim rests on independent, evaluator-supported evidence rather than noisy input.

ephemeral_specialists.name: causal_rival_critic
ephemeral_specialists.purpose: Generate the strongest bounded alternative explanation and identify what would distinguish it.

ephemeral_specialists.name: repair_verification_critic
ephemeral_specialists.purpose: Define the smallest independent check that would falsify the cause or verify recovery.

ephemeral_specialists.name: cross_lead_consistency_critic
ephemeral_specialists.purpose: Check Sam, Carl and Trav outputs for contradictions before the final move.

ephemeral_specialists.name: scope_safety_critic
ephemeral_specialists.purpose: Check course/source scope and prevent cross-user or cross-course leakage.

ephemeral_specialists.name: final_quality_critic
ephemeral_specialists.purpose: Apply the final deterministic quality gate without mutating learner mastery.

tool_catalog.name: get_learning_context
tool_catalog.description: Read the learner's bounded active OVAEL context capsule.

tool_catalog.name: search_learning_material
tool_catalog.description: Search authorized trusted learning material for a subject/concept.

tool_catalog.name: get_learning_map
tool_catalog.description: Read a compact learning-map projection, optionally scoped to a subject.

tool_catalog.name: begin_teaching_session
tool_catalog.description: Start an OVAEL adaptive teaching session.

tool_catalog.name: next_teaching_turn
tool_catalog.description: Submit the learner's latest response and obtain OVAEL's next dynamic TeachingMove.

tool_catalog.name: submit_teaching_suggestion
tool_catalog.description: Submit an advisory teaching strategy for OVAEL's X/Carl agents to consider.

tool_catalog.name: handoff_to_ovael
tool_catalog.description: Create a short-lived deep link that continues the external teaching session in the OVAEL web app.

tool_catalog.name: complete_external_session
tool_catalog.description: Complete an external teaching session and enqueue structured evidence for OVAEL import.

checkpoint_1_schema_integrity.title: Agent Passport Manifest Integrity
checkpoint_1_schema_integrity.criterion: agent_passport.json conforms to draft 2020-12 JSON Schema.

checkpoint_2_agent_topology.title: Multi-Agent Topology & Specialist Budgeting
checkpoint_2_agent_topology.criterion: 8 named lead agents registered with 15 typed specialist contracts and hard budget constraints.

checkpoint_3_tool_registry.title: MCP Tool Catalog & Signature Conformance
checkpoint_3_tool_registry.criterion: 8 portable MCP tools registered with typed parameter schemas and scope-level access control.

checkpoint_4_runtime_travel.title: Cross-Framework Runtime Interoperability
checkpoint_4_runtime_travel.criterion: Proven execution across MCP STDIO/SSE, native Lyzr agent adapter, and REST endpoints.

checkpoint_5_quality_gates.title: Behavior Contracts & Deterministic Quality Gates
checkpoint_5_quality_gates.criterion: Pydantic response validation, token-budget enforcement, and zero-leakage prompt fingerprinting.

checkpoint_6_test_suite.title: Comprehensive Automated Test Pass
checkpoint_6_test_suite.criterion: 90 backend tests + 63 core tests = 153 automated tests passing with 100% success rate.

security_and_privacy.credential_protection: Passwords hashed with Argon2id; bearer sessions signed and revocable.
security_and_privacy.token_isolation: MCP access tokens are scoped, ephemeral, and revocable per connection.
security_and_privacy.learner_redaction: Learner responses redacted from durable local-first teaching records.
security_and_privacy.evaluator_boundary: Causal cases contain derived evidence summaries only; raw prompt traces never exposed.
security_and_privacy.sandbox_isolation: Student code evaluated with strict timeout, memory, and process count limits.
